title: Lost & Found
escalation: Please have your child check with the school office, or contact the office directly for next steps. This bot cannot see Lost & Found inventory.

identify_item.prompt: I can help! What did your child lose?

clothing_checked.prompt: Has your child checked Lost & Found in the cafeteria and outside the gym?

clothing_not_yet.prompt: Ask your child to check both locations during the school day. Students are generally expected to retrieve their own belongings.

clothing_checked_office.prompt: Have your child ask the school office whether the item has been turned in. It may also help to check again later.

student_id_answer.prompt: Parents reported that replacement IDs are available through the school office for $5. Please confirm the current fee and procedure with the office.

chromebook_answer.prompt: Please notify the school office and your child's teacher promptly. They can explain the school's missing-device procedure. This bot cannot report or track devices.

bus_answer.prompt: Parents recommended contacting First Student with the bus number and route details. Some drivers retain found items for the next morning, but this is not guaranteed.
